The `geometric_depth_auditor` found no grounding issues, and the `topology_boundary_auditor` confirmed clean masks, suggesting the structural integrity is high despite the text failures. I agree with the Router's findings but emphasize that the text artifacts are the primary defect.

All visible diagnostic checkpoints (shape, windows, wheels, livery) are met. The only missing elements are due to occlusion (rear view), not generation failure. Therefore, alignment is near-perfect.
